== Title ==
<span lang="ja">コレリアン・コルベット</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">パイロットを3名、乗客を4名、ビークルを1台乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットを持つ。</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">反乱軍の多目的ブロッケード・ランナー。兵員や物資輸送のため内部はモジュラー構造になっている。全長150メートル。反乱軍、宇宙海賊、宇宙企業、帝国軍に使われている。</span><ref name="japanese-face" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Corellian Corvette</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
<blockquote>A multi-purpose Rebel Blockade Runner. Its interior is modular for transporting troops or supplies. Overall length 150 meters. Used by the Rebels, space pirates, space corporations and the Imperial forces.</blockquote>

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>May carry 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has docking capability. Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.</blockquote>

The Japanese game text gives the same passenger, pilot and vehicle capacities and permanent-pilot ability as the original English printing. It says docking capability, while the English says ship-docking capability. The Japanese lore expands pirates and corporations to space pirates and space corporations.<ref name="japanese-face" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-corelliancorvette.gif|Original English Corellian Corvette card face]].</ref>

'''Original English counterpart game text'''
<blockquote>May add 3 pilots, 4 passengers and 1 vehicle. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 1.</blockquote><ref name="english-face" />


== Variants ==
About half of the Japanese copies have a stray mark in the printed title. The mark is part of the print-sheet layout.<ref name="japanese-face" />
